fusions.name: Sprung Needle
fusions.desc: Springs you onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and bites, which deals 12 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unseen Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes 3 claws in a tight spread out to 3 tiles, each of which deals 3 damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Stalk
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds, and you move 22% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ninth Dragline
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
